name: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe
label: Quest
description: Lost Thunderbrew Recipe: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is rumored that the Dark Iron Hurley Blackbreath has stolen a recipe for ale. This ale, Thunderbrew Lager, is said to infuse its imbiber with great strength and courage. We wish to study the drink. Perhaps, we will find other applications for its virtues... Applications more in line with Forsaken objectives.
Delve into Blackrock Depths, find Hurley, take from him the recipe for Thunderbrew lager and bring it to me.
And to find him, you may have to entice him by threatening his precious ale.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the recipe for the Thunderbrew Lager, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. I will send this recipe to the Apothecarium to be studied, and in time we will unlock its secrets. One day, the dwarves of the Alliance may find the virtues of this drink used against them!
I find that terribly amusing. Perhaps death has an affect on one's sense of humor... Do you think?
